whoItsFor: Developers and founders who want to study an existing app and rebuild its features and flows as their own product. It suits people who want a clone they can rebrand and sell.
useCases: Reverse-engineer an app's screens, flows and data model into a recon map
Rebuild the clone screen by screen, then test it for bugs and score parity against the original
Rebrand the clone, write its landing page and store listing, and deploy it to your own domain
